At some point after the [[Battle of Mindor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of '''technobeasts''' were created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trailia]] by a [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] known as [[Cronal]]. While residing on Trailia, Cronal spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] experimenting on the [[Trailian|native inhabitants]] using his [[Stygian Art]], a technique derived from a combination of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and the [[Force power/Legends|power]] of ''[[mechu-deru]]''. As a result of these experiments, a number of Trailians were transformed into [[mutant]]s called technobeasts. The Dark Side Adept eventually traveled away from Trailia with the finest of his creations, taking refuge on the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Corsuscant]]. After doing so, Cronal was forced flee with his life when a subject of his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] experiments—[[Irek Ismaren]]—grew unstable, sacrificing the Trailian technobeasts to ensure his survival.<ref name="DOAE" />
